subsystems.name: Session event log and request reconstruction
subsystems.problem: Keep durable history, model context, replay, and UI projections aligned.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Typed append-only events, immutable JSON snapshots, deriveMessages, request-header logging, and a reconstruction invariant.
subsystems.recommendation: Port first as the authoritative agent-history model.

subsystems.name: Guarded tool execution
subsystems.problem: Give every model-requested action one enforceable and observable execution path.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Registry, pre-policy, approval, monotonic guards, around execution, post-policy, immutable final result, and composed cancellation.
subsystems.recommendation: Port with approval before adding mutating tools.

subsystems.name: Capability seam pattern
subsystems.problem: Replace implementations without leaking provider details into callers.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Provider-neutral definition, provider registration, consumer adapter, stable failures, fake-provider tests, and explicit disposal.
subsystems.recommendation: Adopt for capabilities with multiple providers or real security and lifecycle ownership.

subsystems.name: Approval service
subsystems.problem: Resolve one human decision at the operation that requires authority.
subsystems.minimal_slice: One-shot outcomes, ask and never policy, asked and decided audit events, cancellation, and fail-closed missing answerers.
subsystems.recommendation: Port as part of the tool executor, not as a UI-only feature.

subsystems.name: Cordis effects and quiescent disposal
subsystems.problem: Make dynamically registered work removable without leaks or reentrant teardown races.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Ownership registered before setup, explicit lifecycle states, idempotent disposer, unload snapshot, child ownership, and quiescent cleanup.
subsystems.recommendation: Port the lifecycle rules through a disposer stack and AbortController before adopting Cordis wholesale.

subsystems.name: Session projections
subsystems.problem: Derive query and UI state from one durable event history.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Pure synchronous reducers, JSON state, versioned checkpoints, replay, and detached snapshots.
subsystems.recommendation: Port after the event log when several read models need the same facts.

subsystems.name: Prompt and tool-schema assembly
subsystems.problem: Keep model instructions, variables, contexts, and executable tool schemas deterministic and scoped.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Ordered section registry, strict variables, dynamic contexts, schema contributions, deterministic ordering, and optional scoped overlays.
subsystems.recommendation: Port after the tool registry so prompt claims match effective capabilities.

subsystems.name: Provider-neutral LLM runtime
subsystems.problem: Bind a model call to one adapter generation and stable failure vocabulary.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Adapter registry, explicit default resolution, immutable prepared call, cancellation, stream vocabulary, and provider error normalization.
subsystems.recommendation: Port when an application has more than one provider or hot-swappable routes.
known_risks: adapter drift between prepare and dispatch
middleware bugs hidden as provider errors

subsystems.name: Append-only persistence contract
subsystems.problem: Persist contiguous event history with an explicit durability promise.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Create, append, load, flush, format version, contiguity validation, and one JSONL backend.
subsystems.recommendation: Port the service contract and a small backend, not the complete coordinator initially.

subsystems.name: Sandbox policy and evidence contract
subsystems.problem: Describe and enforce per-call file-effect confinement without overstating isolation.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Per-call mode and root, argv confinement, enforcement evidence, and fail-closed unsupported hosts.
subsystems.recommendation: Port the abstract contract; choose providers per target platform.
known_risks: file confinement described as hostile-code isolation

subsystems.name: One-shot subagents
subsystems.problem: Delegate bounded work while retaining lineage, cancellation, result, and disposal ownership.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Named providers, one-shot request, typed terminal result, run holder, capability checks, publication after readiness, and disposal.
subsystems.recommendation: Port only when an application has a concrete delegation use case.

subsystems.name: Profiles, bundles, and overlays
subsystems.problem: Compose deployment modes without forking the runtime core.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Named profile, ordered module IDs, full config replacement, complete candidate validation, effective-config dump, and rollback-covered swap.
subsystems.recommendation: Prefer a simpler explicit composition format until live plugin installation is required.

subsystems.name: Rollback-covered loader reconciliation
subsystems.problem: Apply live configuration updates without discarding the last good tree.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Parse, validate, prepare, apply, settle, commit; on failure dispose candidate, restore previous state, and report rollback failures.
subsystems.recommendation: Port the commit-after-settlement discipline only when live reload is required.

subsystems.name: Workflow execution
subsystems.problem: Orchestrate multiple bounded agent calls with typed terminal results.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Prefer an application-owned declarative DAG with caps, cancellation, JSON crossing, and typed results.
subsystems.recommendation: Do not port model-authored JavaScript unless the product requirement justifies its risk and complexity.
known_risks: VM mistaken for a security boundary

subsystems.name: Web contracts and generated RPC
subsystems.problem: Project plugin services over a strict transport-independent request and result protocol.
subsystems.minimal_slice: Explicit JSON-RPC or HTTP schemas, exact codecs, carrier-independent dispatcher, stable errors, transport-owned authentication, and a built HTTP smoke.
subsystems.recommendation: Use conventional schemas unless generated plugin RPC is a concrete requirement.
